title.zh: Kalshi Launches US 500 Perpetual Future With No Expiration
title.en: Kalshi Launches US 500 Perpetual Future With No Expiration

current_state.zh: Kalshi launched a US 500 perpetual future with no expiration date, settling through daily funding payments and futures-account collateral, with maximum leverage of roughly 15.3x shown at launch.
current_state.en: Kalshi launched a US 500 perpetual future with no expiration date, settling through daily funding payments and futures-account collateral, with maximum leverage of roughly 15.3x shown at launch.

updates.title_zh: Kalshi 推出无到期日的 US 500 永续期货
updates.title_en: Kalshi Launches US 500 Perpetual Future With No Expiration
updates.what_changed_zh:
Kalshi 推出了无到期日的 US 500 永续期货，通过每日资金费支付和期货账户保证金进行结算。上线时显示的最高杠杆约为 15.3 倍。

该产品把永续期货机制——每日资金费、无到期日、以期货账户资产作保证金——从加密资产和金属扩展到美国宽基股票指数，且是在受 CFTC 监管的交易场所推出。

据报道，该合约为现金结算，标的为 MerQube 美国大盘指数，该指数按自由流通调整市值覆盖美国上市及美国注册的 500 家最大公司。

updates.background_zh: 据报道，Kalshi 于 8 月 18 日提交了 US500 与铜永续期货的申请，在不到三个月内从单一加密产品扩展到股票指数和工业金属。Kalshi 将这一扩张描述为把永续期货从加密资产和金属推向股票领域。
updates.background_en: Reports say Kalshi filed for US500 and copper perpetual futures on Aug. 18, moving from a single crypto product into equity indexes and industrial metals in under three months. Kalshi has described the expansion as taking perpetual futures beyond cryptocurrencies and metals into equities.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次上线把加密原生永续结构——尤其是将永续价格与标的挂钩的资金费机制——带入受 CFTC 监管的美国股票指数敞口，可能影响合规永续交易场所与离岸交易所在保证金和交易流量上的竞争格局。其实际影响取决于该产品能否吸引成交量，以及资金费相对标的指数的设定方式。
updates.market_impact_en: The launch pushes crypto-native perpetual structure — notably the funding-rate mechanism that ties perp prices to an underlying reference — into US equity index exposure on a CFTC-regulated venue, which could shape how regulated perp venues compete with offshore exchanges for margin and trading flow. Any read-through depends on whether the product attracts volume and how funding is set relative to the underlying index.
